name: Arca Mpu Baradah
sam3_prompt: Balinese carved stone statue of a sacred figure
description: A sacred image cared for by the community of Pura Ntegana in Darmasaba, Badung. Local belief connects the arca with prayers for safety and taksu — a spiritual quality sought by those called to serve as pemangku.
history: The statue belongs to the living setting of Pura Ntegana. Some accounts date it to 908 CE and connect it with the Purusada period; the date is presented here as a recorded tradition, rather than a settled fact.
cultural_meaning: The arca is more than a carved figure. For people who come to pray, it is a focus for seeking safety, spiritual strength and guidance in service to the community.
location: Pura Ntegana, Jl. Tanah Putih, Darmasaba, Kecamatan Abiansemal, Kabupaten Badung, Bali, Indonesia
